apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.3  (November 2026)  THE MENU AND EVERY PAGE SCROLL; A CLEAR SEARCH SIGN
  - The left menu scrolls when the window is lower than the menu (on a laptop, or with bigger letters, the pages after
    ADMIN were cut off). The version line stays at the bottom.
  - Every page (Offering Slips to Settings & Audit) scrolls when the window is lower than the page: what was hidden at
    the bottom is reached with the scroll bar or the mouse wheel. A page that fits shows no scroll bar. (The Dashboard
    already scrolled.) A list or a text box under the mouse still scrolls itself.
  - The search box has a drawn magnifying glass (the 🔍 letter was tiny on Windows); clicking it searches too.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.44.0 - DEDICATION & BAPTISM REQUESTS FROM THE MEMBER PORTAL (needs Website Update 108)
  - Members ask in the member portal (Me → Baptism): "Dedicate my child", "I want to be baptized" or "I was already
    baptized (record it)", for themself, one of their children or someone else. They agree that the office keeps the
    details, see the status of each request, and download the certificate there when it is ready.
  - Baptism & Dedication has a new tab, Requests (with the number of new ones): open a request to fix the spelling and
    link the member; Accept, Ask to correct (with a note), Not accepted (with a note), Schedule (one date, place, minister
    and witnesses for several at once) and Mark done.
  - Schedule makes the record (not yet on the profile). A dedication certificate can be printed from then on (it is given
    during the service); a baptism certificate only after Mark done. Mark done puts the date on the member's profile,
    makes the certificate (Saved certificates) and puts it in the portal for the member who asked (for a child: the
    child's parents and guardians too). Upload again replaces it after a change.
  - Both computers (Secretary and Attendance) bring the requests in; a decision is written only once, so two computers
    never make two records. Requests that are finished leave the portal after a year (not accepted or cancelled: after 30
    days); this computer keeps them, and the records stay.
